svg.aria-label: Patch matching: every cell of the image is scored against every sign at six sizes
svg.title: Patch matching: every cell of the image is scored against every sign at six sizes
svg.text: Every cell of the picture is scored against every sign, at six sizes. The best match is drawn there.
3 · scored against all 204 candidates (34 signs × 6 sizes, + blank)
score = (cell ink − sign ink)² − 0.03 × texture × correlation(cell, sign)
Flat areas are judged on tone; edges also reward signs whose strokes fall on the dark side. Lowest score wins; near-ties are drawn by seeded chance.
